functions.name: assign-scorecard-to-real-call-session
functions.description: Assign a scorecard to an existing real call session, replacing its previous scorecard association when present.

sessionId.description: Existing real call session identifier on this connection.

scorecardId.description: Scorecard identifier to associate with the session; omission, null and empty values cannot clear the association.

FunctionInput_wejam_assignscorecardtorea.description: Target real call session and scorecard to associate with it.

id.description: Affected real call session identifier returned by the provider.

state.description: Immediate provider processing state; not a completed-analysis guarantee.

completed.description: Whether the provider currently reports the session completed.

updatedAt.description: Session last-update instant normalized to UTC RFC 3339, preserving source precision.

scorecardTitle.description: Associated scorecard title when returned; null and omission remain distinct.

scorecardReferenceId.description: Provider's associated scorecard reference when returned; not assumed identical to the input scorecardId.

FunctionOutput_wejam_assignscorecardtore.description: Immediate assignment receipt, without waiting for completed analysis.

tags.instructions: Use after choosing a scorecard from `list-scorecards` and a session from `list-real-call-sessions` or `create-real-call-session`. This changes the session's scorecard association and may affect analysis; it does not edit transcript content. Use `get-real-call-session` to inspect subsequent state and results. The tool returns the provider's immediate state, not a promise of completed reanalysis. Do not blindly replay an uncertain assignment.

functions.name: create-real-call-session
functions.description: Create a real call session from ordinary transcript text and attribute scoring to one representative. Eligible email uploads and labeled speakers may also provision organization members under the organization's rules.

missionId.description: Optional mission ID used for the scorecard; omitted to leave mission selection unspecified.

transcript.description: Ordinary transcript text: plain text, SRT, or email/speaker-labeled SRT. Sent without base64 encoding or rewriting labels.

meetingName.description: Nonempty name for this meeting, preserving caller text.

scorecardId.description: Optional explicit scorecard ID for analysis; when omitted the provider classifies the transcript and selects a scorecard.

learnerEmail.description: Scored representative's email, used instead of learnerUserId; an unknown address may create a Member only under organization provisioning rules.

learnerUserId.description: Scored representative's user ID in this organization; use instead of learnerEmail.

FunctionInput_wejam_createrealcallsessio.description: Transcript and meeting details with exactly one scored representative selector.

id.description: Created real call session ID; use with get-real-call-session.

state.description: Provider session processing state at creation response time; not a delivery or final-analysis guarantee.

completed.description: Whether the provider already reports the session completed.

createdAt.description: Session creation instant normalized to UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

updatedAt.description: Session last-update instant normalized to UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

learnerUserId.description: Resolved user ID of the scored representative, including a newly provisioned user when applicable.

FunctionOutput_wejam_createrealcallsessi.description: Creation receipt without waiting for transcript processing or final analysis.

tags.instructions: Provide a transcript and exactly one of learnerUserId (from `list-users`) or learnerEmail. The rep must be you or someone you manage. Email-based provisioning requires organization opt-in, an allowed domain and whole-organization management authority, and may consume seats. Optional IDs come from `list-missions` and `list-scorecards`. Plain text and SRT are supported; email-labeled SRT must contain speech by the scored rep. This creates a session, not a completed analysis. Use the returned id with `get-real-call-session` to inspect progress and participants. Do not blindly repeat a successful or uncertain creation.

functions.name: get-real-call-session
functions.description: Get a real call session's processing states, transcript, summary, participant attribution and detailed scorecard analysis by ID.

sessionId.description: Real call session identifier in the connection's organization.

FunctionInput_wejam_getrealcallsession.description: Identifies the real call session to retrieve.

id.description: Opaque call identifier, distinct from session ID.

updatedAt.description: Call last-update instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

transcript.description: Ordinary processed conversation text when reported; null, empty and omission retained.

endedReason.description: Provider reason the call ended when reported; no invented interpretation.

providerCallId.description: External provider's call identifier when reported; null and omission retained.

call.description: Call content and its processing state.

state.description: KPI processing state, independent of scorecard analysis state.

createdAt.description: KPI creation instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

updatedAt.description: KPI last-update instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

kpis.description: KPI identity and processing state; numeric metrics with undocumented units are not exposed.

type.description: Provider session category, always REAL_CALL for this operation.

trackId.description: Parent track identifier when reported; null and omission retained.

name.description: Criterion name when reported; null and omission retained.

score.description: Criterion numerical score in the provider's unspecified scale.

state.description: Criterion evaluation state; ERROR is returned as data, not a failed Get.

solved.description: Criterion solving state when reported; undetected, null and omission remain distinct.

createdAt.description: Criterion creation instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

updatedAt.description: Criterion last-update instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

behaviours.description: Behaviour assessments when supplied; omission is distinct from an empty assessment array.

score.description: Behaviour score in the provider's unspecified scale.

evidence.description: Ordinary text evidence supporting this behaviour assessment, in source order.

suggestion.description: Improvement suggestion when reported; null, empty and omission retained.

explanation.description: Criterion explanation when reported; null, empty and omission retained.

conversationItemReferenceId.description: Provider conversation-item reference when reported; null and omission retained.

items.description: Criterion analyses in source order; may be empty.

score.description: Overall provider score; no scale is documented or inferred.

state.description: Analysis processing state; scores may be provisional before DONE.

createdAt.description: Analysis creation instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

updatedAt.description: Analysis last-update instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

analysis.description: Detailed scorecard analysis and its processing state.

language.description: Session language code, distinct from playedLanguage.

completed.description: Whether the provider reports the session completed.

createdAt.description: Session creation instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

updatedAt.description: Session last-update instant in UTC RFC 3339 with source precision.

trackTitle.description: Associated track title when reported; null and omission retained.

missionTitle.description: Associated mission title when reported; null and omission retained.

learnerUserId.description: Opaque user ID of the exclusively scored representative.

playedLanguage.description: Provider's played-language code when reported; null and omission are distinct from language.

scorecardTitle.description: Associated scorecard title when reported; null and omission retained.

missionReferenceId.description: Provider mission reference, not assumed interchangeable with missionId; omitted if not returned.

participantUserIds.description: User IDs of attributed speakers including the scored rep; [] means no attribution; omitted if not resolved or supplied.

scorecardReferenceId.description: Provider scorecard reference, not assumed interchangeable with scorecardId; omitted if not returned.

FunctionOutput_wejam_getrealcallsession.description: Current real call session snapshot with independent processing states, content, attribution and detailed analysis.

tags.instructions: Use a session id from `create-real-call-session` or `list-real-call-sessions`. This returns the current snapshot without waiting for processing. Inspect session, call, analysis and KPI states before treating scores as final; retrieve again later if needed. Participants may not be resolved until transcript processing finishes. Use `assign-scorecard-to-real-call-session` to change the scorecard, not this read tool.
